title: Language resource manifest
description: Describes a catalog directory supplied to --catalog-dir. The user prepares the directory and is responsible for holding the rights to the messages it contains. This project ships no translation data.

locale.description: Target locale. Both spellings are accepted and written as aliases of the same catalog.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in install output. Defaults to the locale tag.

license.description: Licence you declare for the messages, e.g. 'CC-BY-SA-4.0' or 'self-authored'. Recorded in the install marker and shown in reports. Declaring a licence here does not grant any right to Claude, Claude Desktop or any Anthropic material.

origin.description: Where the messages came from and under what authority, in your own words. Recorded in the install marker.

base.description: Main interface messages. Required and must not be empty.

relativeFile.description: Path relative to the catalog directory. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.
